text:
Priya: Heads-up — seeing ~0.8% of /fn/invoke responses fail structured-schema validation and get routed to the degen path. Quota accounting spikes for some customers. Anyone else noticing this?
Matt: Yup, got the same alert. Is this from the strict-validate canary we flipped yesterday?
Priya: I think so. We turned on strict_validate=true for the canary slice (10%). Here's a raw example from the logs: 
```json
{
  "tool_result": [
    {"name": "search", "output": "..."}
  ]
}
```
Validator expected `tool_result` to be an object: `{ name: string, output: string }` but received an array -> rejected.
Alex: Ok. Two quick angles: 1) telemetry: emit validation_error.code and validation_error.path (e.g. `tool_result.type_mismatch` and `tool_result`) + route_decision (degen|strict_reject|soft_accept) so we can slice by customers. 2) Router: consider soft-accept fallback that coerces array->object for known adapters for a short window.
Jordan: Console UX: we should surface a tiny sampled feed of rejected payloads (redacted) per-route with the reject reason and a one-click toggle to soften strictness for that route. Right now it's invisible unless you dig into logs.
Priya: Soft-accept sounds useful but worried about billing implications if we silently accept. Those invokes currently count against degen quota and inflate error metrics.
Matt: We can mark soft-accepted invokes with a tag `fncall.soft_accepted=true` and `billing_exempt=true` at router time. Downstream billing will treat them as nonbillable until we decide otherwise. Need product signoff.
Alex: Also add a metric `validation_coercions_applied` so we can monitor how often router mutated responses. If coercions spike, that's a signal to patch model/adapters.
Jordan: For rollout UX: add a per-route strictness ramp slider (0-100%) and an automatic rollback if validation_reject_rate > 0.5% over 5m. Show that on the route page.
Priya: Agreed. Immediate ask: can we reduce canary slice to 1% for strict_validate while we add telemetry and sampling?
deploy-bot: Canary update: strict_validate slice adjusted from 10% -> 1% at 3795000012 by @Priya.
ops-bot: Alert: validation_reject_count spike resolved? currently still ~0.2% overall on the route.
Matt: Action items: (1) Alex adds telemetry keys + metric names, (2) Jordan wires minimal console sample UI (redacted), (3) Priya tracks rollback rules + ask product on billing label. I'll make a small RFC for soft-accept counting.
Priya: I'll follow up with a few log excerpts and customer-impact list. Please don't re-enable wider canary until metrics land. :pray:
